title: Specification of gate sealing
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $L$ be a list of vertex indices, let $G$ be a list of gates, and let $o$ be a vertex index. Suppose $G$ is acyclic, $o<n+|G|$, and every index in $L$ is less than $n+|G|$. Sealing the indices in $L$ starting from $(G,o)$ produces a gate list and output index such that the new list extends $G$ by gates with distinct arguments and the prescribed argument count (one for a NOT gate and two otherwise), the new list is acyclic, the new output is a valid vertex, and its value agrees with the value of vertex $o$ in $G$ on every Boolean input in $\{0,1\}^n$.
hypotheses_covered: Every index in $L$ is less than $n+|G|$
